macros.name: cmnum
macros.doc: The command \cmnum switches back to Arabic numerals.

macros.name: datemodernhindi
macros.doc: Macros \datehindi and \datemodernhindi enable Europian style Hindi date generated by the standard \today command.

macros.name: devanagari
macros.doc: You can use the command \devanagari as an alternative to \arabic to control the style of a counter anywhere in the document.

macros.name: dn
macros.doc: The basic delimiter is the \dn macro. This delimiter is used by enclosing Devanāgarı̄ text between {\dn ... }, eg. {\dn acchaa}.

macros.name: dncalcutta
macros.doc: Access to the Calcutta family within Devanāgarı̄ environments should be restricted to the \dncalcutta macro.

macros.name: dnnepali
macros.doc: To access this family, use the command \dnnepali after the \dn macro.

macros.name: dnnum
macros.doc: The command \dnnum switches to Devanāgarı̄ numerals.

macros.name: dnoriginal
macros.doc: Use the command \dnoriginal to return to the standard Devanāgarı̄ font.

macros.name: dnpen
macros.doc: Use the command \dnpen to return to the standard Devanāgarı̄ Pen font.

macros.name: dnpenbombay
macros.doc: The Pen family for the Bombay style are available as the family dnpb, and may be accessed with the command \dnpenbombay.

macros.name: dnpencalcutta
macros.doc: The Pen family for the Calcutta style is called dnpc and may be accessed with the command \dnpencalcutta.

macros.name: dnpennepali
macros.doc: The Pen family for the Nepali style is called dnpn and may be accessed with the command \dnpennepali.

macros.name: dnveda
macros.doc: To use the Rig Veda macros, you must first enter the command \dnveda at some point after \input dnmacs in plain TeX or after \usepackage{devanagari} in LaTeX, and to use the Sama Veda accents, you must first type \dnsamaveda.

macros.name: NormalFont
macros.doc: The font commands \rsize (Plain TeX) and \NormalFont (LaTeX) put Roman text within Devanāgarı̄ Text.

macros.name: UnDevCatcodes
macros.doc: The macro \UnDevCatcodes changes catcodes back to the normal values within the \dn environment.
